_comment: A unit's cost is multiplied by costGrowthPerVillage for each village its owner has beyond the first (settlers). Combat stats (attack, defense) are used by battles from M1 step 5. speed is hexes per hour on plains; upkeepPerHour is grain. Training time shrinks by trainingSpeedup per level of the training building above its first. A unit with `clan` is that clan's own: only its members train it.

spearman.name: Spearman
spearman.description: Cheap, steady infantry that holds the walls and stops riders.

archer.name: Archer
archer.description: Shoots hard at infantry; riders cut them down.

horseman.name: Horseman
horseman.description: Fast riders that strike hard and run down archers.

scout.name: Scout
scout.description: Rides out to see a horde's numbers before it arrives.

settler.name: Settler
settler.description: Founds a new village where you send them; no use in a fight.

forest_archer.name: Forest Archer
forest_archer.description: The lynx-folk's own: archers who strike from the trees.

river_barge.name: River Barge
river_barge.description: The beaver-folk's own: a river crew who carry a great load and hold firm.

border_rider.name: Border Rider
border_rider.description: The falcon-folk's own: light riders who see far and ride fast.
